- the PLC code has been kept as simple as it can be, and is totally independent from the Alarm-Action Ma trix and from the parameterization of the Input and Output channels; - the Alarm-Action matrix is stored in a set of datablocks, which are the only source of data for the PLC code; - the parameterization of Input and Output channels is stored in a different set of datablocks, which are also the only source of parameterization for the PLC code

• the datadriven approach is the right one to use for the design of a safety-critical system that needs to be easily configurable by the user; • the OPC mechanism is the right one for the communication between the PLC and the Back-End.

it is possible to design a system that can be easily modified at runtime, without stopping the operation, by using only a datadriven approach, without the need of introducing any additional software layer between the user interface and the hardware.
